title: plan.json
description: Top-level plan file. Contains an experiment_list and a parallel dependencies array (dependencies[i] holds the prerequisite experiment_ids for experiment_list[i]).

dependencies.description: Positional companion to experiment_list: dependencies[i] is the list of prerequisite experiment_ids for experiment_list[i]. generate_plan fills this by chaining experiments that share a server_config_id.

experiment_id.description: Unique, monotonically assigned at plan generation time.

serve_cmd.description: Full shell command to start the SGLang server (run via SSH, backgrounded by runner).

bench_cmd.description: Full shell command to run the benchmark (includes --output-file pointing at a remote path).

output_file.description: Local path where the wrapped result JSON is written after scp.

server_config_id.description: Stable id for a unique server flag combination. Shared across experiments that only differ in dataset/concurrency.
